## Upgrade Instructions

```bash
git pull
./update.sh
```

Windows:

```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\update.ps1
```

## Flash ESP32

Windows:

```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\flash-esp.ps1 -InstallIfMissing
```

Linux/macOS:

```bash
./flash-esp.sh
```
